title: [SEC4] static_files.rs: SPA fallback heuristic not explained
description:
The SPA fallback logic at lines 20-21 uses !path.contains('.') to decide whether to serve index.html. The comment says 'route has no extension, serve index.html' but does NOT explain the critical invariant:

The heuristic ASSUMES that all actual static assets (CSS, JS, images, fonts, etc.) have file extensions, and all SPA routes are extensionless. This breaks if:
- A new API endpoint is added that is extensionless (e.g., /api/endpoint).
- A static asset is added without an extension.

A maintainer adding new routes or static files needs to understand this constraint to avoid silent failures (extensionless paths serving index.html instead of 404-ing).

Add a comment explaining: 'Routes with no file extension are assumed to be SPA routes; all static assets must have extensions (.js, .css, .png, etc.)'
